title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Switch Bills
content:
A switch bill, within `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents`, is a fresh negotiable set issued in exchange for an existing one and naming different parties; an intermediary commonly uses it to keep its supplier out of view. This page states when a switch can be made, how the new document is built and how the exchange is charged.

## Conditions

1. **Exchangeable types.** Only a document whose type permits switching can be the subject of a switch request.
2. **Switch count on the booking.** The request is admissible only while the switches already made on the booking remain below the type's switch limit. The switches are counted across every document of the booking, as the switch bill fees booked on documents of that booking.
3. **Role of the requester.** The documentation party requesting the switch must have a customer role that the `AHL Switch Bill of Lading` type admits.
4. **Exchanged set given up.** The existing set is exchanged only once all of its originals have been surrendered at the origin office.

## How the new document is formed

5. The draft for the switch bill is a new document of the `AHL Switch Bill of Lading` type on the same booking. The new parties are printed exactly as the documentation party supplies them; the cargo particulars, ports and weights are carried over from the exchanged document without change.
6. The switch bill goes through the ordinary draft approval and issue rules. At the moment it is issued, the exchanged document is voided and the switch bill fee is charged on that exchanged document.
7. The switch fee may be entered only on the exchanged document and only while that document is in the status surrendered. No switch request is charged twice.
8. A switch bill is never itself switched again.

## Values by document type

| Document type | Switching permitted | Switches per booking (maximum) | Switch bill fee (USD per switch, charged on the exchanged document) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | 1 | 185.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | 1 | 210.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

| Facts on record | Judgement |
|---|---|
| `AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading`, booking with no switch fee booked, full set surrendered at origin, requester's role admitted by the switch type | Switch may proceed; 185.00 is charged on the negotiable document when the switch bill is issued |
| `AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading`, a switch fee already booked on the booking | Not admissible: the limit of 1 is used |
| `AHL Straight Bill of Lading` | Not admissible: the type does not permit switching |
| An `AHL Switch Bill of Lading` presented for a further switch | Never switched again |

## Basis Q&A

**Can the switch bill correct the gross weight at the same time?** No. Cargo particulars, ports and weights pass unchanged from the exchanged document.

**On which document does the switch fee appear?** On the document given up in the exchange, not on the new switch bill.
